items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★1 Unfortunately, if you were drawn here du
items.summary: Unfortunately, if you were drawn here due to YouTube videos praising the game and the dev, things have changed quite drastically. Gameplay has been changed in a way that is very unpopular with the community. Endgame has been changed and inflated hp values completely screwed both invested players and new players building towards those teams. Units getting "bug fixed" right after a re-run. Light, the producer has been caught lying and backpedaling repeatedly about these changes. Memento Mori.

items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★1 Recent update crept the HP of endgame by
items.summary: Recent update crept the HP of endgame by more than 10x the previous value, killing the viability of most units. Beware that you can brick your account by pulling unoptimally, as it may be impossible for your favorite unit to do endgame even after investing all you can (16 copies of the unit, plus copies of their respective supports - up to 48 copies, plus their wheels/weapon) into them. Disappointing response to the nerf disguised as a bugfix, when it has been known and communicated for a year.
